protocol.revision: 2026-10-20: spacing changed from 2,048 to 1,024 after the first run, because 2,048 never lands on the historical 5,120-step endpoint used as a consistency check. Threshold, budget, seeds and evaluation are unchanged; spacing does not alter training (tests/test_curves.py).
protocol.eval_seed_rule: 1000 + training seed; the same 30 Slicer episodes at every checkpoint
protocol.eval_policy: greedy (argmax), no sampling, so evaluation leaves training RNG untouched
protocol.threshold_metric: per-seed mean fruit score over the 30 evaluation episodes
protocol.threshold_rule: first checkpoint at or above the threshold; seeds that never reach it are right-censored at total_steps
